dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談できてくださったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 大学受験を控えた子供がおりますが、ゲームばかりで困っています
dialogue.English: I have a child preparing for university entrance exams, but they just play games all the time, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: それはご心配になってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: That must be worrying for you.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お子さんは息子さんですか？お嬢さんですか？
dialogue.English: Is your child a son or a daughter?

dialogue.content: 息子です
dialogue.English: He's my son.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんは一日どれくらいゲームをやっていらっしゃる感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About how many hours a day does your son seem to be playing games?

dialogue.content: 夜中になると始まり、多分3時間か4時間はやっているようです
dialogue.English: He starts late at night, and I think he probably plays for about three or four hours.

dialogue.content: 昼間は夏休みに入りましたし、眠っています
dialogue.English: And since it's summer vacation now, he sleeps during the day.

dialogue.content: 夏休みになると生活のリズムが崩れがちですよね。。
dialogue.English: During summer vacation, it's easy for daily routines to get disrupted, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんとは受験のことについてお話しされたりしているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to talk with your son about the entrance exams?

dialogue.content: 話そうとするのですが、はぐらかされて話してくれないんです
dialogue.English: I try to talk about it, but he dodges the subject and won't engage.

dialogue.content: 何を考えているのやら
dialogue.English: I have no idea what he's thinking.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。考えていることがわからないと、ご両親としては不安になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... When you don't know what he's thinking, it must be unsettling for you as a parent.

dialogue.content: 受験のこと以外はお話しされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you talk about things other than the exams?

dialogue.content: 殆ど無いですね、お腹が空いたから食べる物は？と言ってくるくらいです
dialogue.English: Hardly at all. It's mostly just him asking, 'I'm hungry, what is there to eat?'

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。必要なことだけだと、寂しい気持ちと心配になってしまいますね。。
dialogue.English: I see. It must feel lonely and worrisome when it's only about necessities.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 塾には出かけて行って一応勉強はしているんですが
dialogue.English: He does go to his cram school, so I suppose he's studying there...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: コロナの時期からリモート授業が続いて、授業しか行っていないし、
dialogue.English: Ever since the pandemic, his classes have been remote, and he's only going for those lessons,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 塾の面談でも先生にはこのままだとまずいと言われているんです
dialogue.English: And at his parent-teacher conference at the cram school, the teacher told us that at this rate, things don't look good.

dialogue.content: 大学へは行きたいみたいなんですが
dialogue.English: He seems to want to go to university, though.

dialogue.content: 何とかなると思っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I wonder if he thinks things will just work out somehow.

dialogue.content: 塾の面談は息子さんとお二人だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was the cram school meeting just you and your son?

dialogue.content: 3者面談です
dialogue.English: It was a three-way conference.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。面談ではどのようなお話しをされるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of things were discussed at the meeting?

dialogue.content: 先生の前ではやりますみたいな発言をするくせに、全く行動が伴いません
dialogue.English: In front of the teacher, he says things like 'I'll do it,' but his actions don't match his words at all.

dialogue.content: んー。。。そうですかぁ。コロナもありますし、なかなかモチベーションを保ちにくい環境ですものね。。
dialogue.English: Hmm... I see. With the pandemic and everything, it must be a difficult environment to stay motivated in.

dialogue.content: しっかり計画的に取り組みます。みたいな宣言をしてみせます
dialogue.English: He makes declarations like, 'I'll work on it properly and systematically.'

dialogue.content: そうなんですが、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, but...

dialogue.content: 困りました。
dialogue.English: I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: そうですね、ご心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it must be worrying.

dialogue.content: 学費も高いですし、行く気が無いなら無いで言って欲しいとは伝えているんですが
dialogue.English: Tuition is expensive, and I've told him that if he doesn't want to go, he should just say so.

dialogue.content: 甘えなのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is he just being spoiled, I wonder?

dialogue.content: 息子さんの意思が見えないと、困惑してしまいますね・・
dialogue.English: It must be confusing when you can't see what your son's intentions are.

dialogue.content: 大学受験以外ではいままでどのような様子で勉強されていたのですか？
dialogue.English: Besides the university exams, what were his study habits like before?

dialogue.content: 必ずゲームが近くにあって、試験勉強は殆どしないので成績もふるいません
dialogue.English: He always has games nearby and hardly studies for tests, so his grades aren't good.

dialogue.content: 中学受験をさせた時が一番頑張っていました
dialogue.English: He tried the hardest when we had him take the junior high school entrance exams.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！中学受験のときはどう頑張られていたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see! How did he work so hard for his junior high entrance exams?

dialogue.content: ゲームはたまにやるくらいで、塾の先生が厳しくしてくださったので何とか頑張れました
dialogue.English: He only played games occasionally, and because his cram school teacher was strict, he managed to persevere.

dialogue.content: 入学以降の成績は下がるばかりです
dialogue.English: Since entering junior high, his grades have only gone down.

dialogue.content: うんうん。中学受験の時はご両親も安心してみていられた感じだったのですね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It sounds like you as parents could watch over him with peace of mind during his junior high exams.

dialogue.content: 小学生なら少しは親の言うこともききますからね
dialogue.English: When he was in elementary school, he at least listened to what his parents said a bit.

dialogue.content: しかし、今はしゃべろうともしない
dialogue.English: But now, he won't even try to talk.

dialogue.content: お話ししようともしないというのは、ご両親としてはしんどいですね。。
dialogue.English: It must be tough for you as parents when he won't even try to talk.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 受験のことは息子さんがお決めになられたのですか？
dialogue.English: Did your son decide to take the entrance exams himself?

dialogue.content: 大学に行く、とか、どこの大学を受験する、とか。
dialogue.English: Like, whether to go to university, or which one to apply to.

dialogue.content: 友達と見学に行き、行きたい大学を決めたようです
dialogue.English: He went on a campus tour with friends and seems to have decided on a university he wants to attend.

dialogue.content: 偏差値の低い学部を狙っているので大丈夫なんだとたまにボヤキます
dialogue.English: He sometimes mutters that he’ll be fine because he’s aiming for a department with lower admissions standards.

dialogue.content: そのお話しは聞いていらっしゃるんですね。そしてお友達と決めたと。学部や大学名は聞いていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you’ve heard that, and that he decided with his friends. Have you heard the name of the department or the university?

dialogue.content: 大学名は聞いていますが、学部はごまかします
dialogue.English: I've heard the name of the university, but he dodges the question about the department.

dialogue.content: 今の成績ではどこの学部も難しいかと思います。
dialogue.English: With his current grades, I think any department would be difficult.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。難しいと思われているのはどのようなことからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What makes you think it would be difficult?

dialogue.content: 偏差値と、今の息子の模試などの成績からです。とにかく、目標に向かって頑張る子になって欲しいです。
dialogue.English: Based on the required entrance scores and his current mock exam results. Anyway, I just want him to be someone who works hard toward a goal.

dialogue.content: そうですね、目標をもって頑張っている姿を見られるのはうれしいですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's wonderful to see him working hard toward a goal.

dialogue.content: ご家族は他にどなたがいらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Who else is in your family?

dialogue.content: 主人と大学4年の娘がおります？
dialogue.English: My husband and my daughter, who is a fourth-year university student.

dialogue.content: 娘は一浪して国立に入ったような子です
dialogue.English: My daughter is the type who got into a national university after studying for an extra year.

dialogue.content: 娘は負けず嫌い
dialogue.English: My daughter hates to lose.

dialogue.content: しかし、息子に聞くと、プライドは無いと言います。
dialogue.English: But when I ask my son, he says he has no pride.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お嬢さんは国立なのですね！頑張って勉強されたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your daughter is at a national university! She must have studied very hard.

dialogue.content: やる時はやる子です
dialogue.English: She's the type who gets things done when she needs to.

dialogue.content: しかし、勉強するのは本人ですから、任せるしか無いと思うようになってきました
dialogue.English: But he's the one who has to study, so I've started to think that I have no choice but to leave it to him.

dialogue.content: すごいですね。やらなければならないときにやれるということは素晴らしいですよね。
dialogue.English: That's amazing. Being able to do what needs to be done when it has to be done is a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: まあ、自分に負けるのが嫌なのかと思いますが
dialogue.English: Well, I suppose she just hates losing to herself.

dialogue.content: 息子は楽を選びますね。色々と
dialogue.English: My son, on the other hand, chooses the easy way out in many things.

dialogue.content: そう見えていらっしゃるのですね。ご主人とは、息子さんの受験についてどのようにお話ししていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: That's how it appears to you. How do you and your husband discuss your son's exams?

dialogue.content: 主人は無関心な人です
dialogue.English: My husband is indifferent.

dialogue.content: 昔から私に任せきりです
dialogue.English: He has always left everything to me.

dialogue.content: ろくに、息子とそういう話しはしたがりません
dialogue.English: He hardly ever wants to have that kind of talk with our son.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、お嬢さんの時はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see... How was it with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 同じでした
dialogue.English: It was the same.

dialogue.content: 関心はない人です
dialogue.English: He’s just not interested.

dialogue.content: お一人で抱えていらっしゃるのですね・・。少ししんどくはないですか？
dialogue.English: So you're handling this all on your own... Isn't that a little tough?

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: 昔から子育てには関心が無い人ですから
dialogue.English: He's never been interested in raising the children.

dialogue.content: 仕事だけの人ですから
dialogue.English: He's all about work.

dialogue.content: そう思われてるのですね。。よろしければ、こちらで息子さんのこと以外もお気持ちお伺いしますので言ってくださいね。
dialogue.English: That's how you feel... If you'd like, you can talk about your own feelings here, not just about your son. Please feel free to share.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます？でも、最近思います。息子の人生なので、自分で失敗したら、後で気づくでしょうし、見守る以外は無いなかと…
dialogue.English: Thank you. But lately, I've been thinking... It's my son's life, so if he fails, he'll realize it later. Maybe there's nothing for me to do but watch over him...

dialogue.content: 私のやるべきことはやりましたし、あとは彼が失敗と成功を繰り返しながら進んでいくしか無いと思うようになってきました
dialogue.English: I’ve done what I should, and I’ve come to feel that from here on, he just has to move forward through his own failures and successes.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうですね。息子さんが幸せであれば大学に行っても行かなくても、いいのではないかと思います。幸せの形は色々ありますものね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. That's true. As long as your son is happy, it might not matter whether he goes to university or not. There are many forms of happiness, after all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それも、彼の人生の形です
dialogue.English: That, too, is the shape of his life.

dialogue.content: きが楽になってきました
dialogue.English: I’m starting to feel more at ease.

dialogue.content: よかったです。お母さまとしてはしっかりやるべきことをやっていらっしゃるようにお話しを伺っていて思いました。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. Listening to your story, I feel that you have been doing everything you should as a mother.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自分なりに一生懸命やってきましたのでこれで良いかと思います
dialogue.English: I’ve done my best in my own way, so I think this is fine.

dialogue.content: 息子さんが甘えていたとしても、どうにかなると思っていたとしても、お母さまは変わってあげることはできないし、最後まで見守ることが大切なのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: Even if your son is being dependent or assuming things will work out on their own, you can't live his life for him. I think what's important is to keep watching over him until the end.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 一生懸命やってこられたのだな、とお話し伺って私は感じましたよ。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, I really get the sense that you have been trying your hardest.

dialogue.content: はい、ただ、最後まで私の気持ちや経験からの思いは伝え続けようと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, but I will continue to convey to him my feelings and the thoughts that come from my own experience, right to the end.

dialogue.content: 気持ちが決まりました。
dialogue.English: I’ve made up my mind.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ご自身の気持ちもしっかり伝えていってあげてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Yes. Please make sure to clearly convey your own feelings to him.

dialogue.content: はい、それは最後までやり遂げるつもりです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I intend to see that through to the end.

dialogue.content: そして、君のことを信じていると伝えるつもりです
dialogue.English: And I plan to tell him, 'I believe in you.'

dialogue.content: 素敵な言葉ですね！ぜひ、伝えてみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Those are wonderful words! Please, do try telling him that.

dialogue.content: はい！今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes! Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: スッキリしました
dialogue.English: I feel much clearer now.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。スッキリしていただけてよかったです。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. I'm glad to hear you feel clearer.

dialogue.content: また、なにかあればいつでも相談にきてくださいね。
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: ではこちらで終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We’ll end here for today then.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （こちらで終了させていただきますね。ロールプレイ、ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (We’ll end here. Thank you for the role-play!)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
